verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OBUDDE buzibye
Enjuba-egenze
Enzikiza-ekwata
Mu bbanga ly'ensi.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Buli nsolo yonna,
Era n'ennyonyi,
Byonna biwummula
Byebaka-otulo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ayi Mukama waffe,
Ontunuulire,
Kaakano nkusaba,
Ompe-ekisa kyo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ebyonoono byange,
Binkwasa-ensonyi;
Naye-olw'ekisa kyo,
Tongoba w'oli.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Bwe neebaka-otulo,
Mu kiro kino;
Bamalayika bo
Bajje bankuume.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ate bwe bunaakya,
Nga ngolokose,
Mbeere mu maaso go
Omulongoofu.
